description: Keeps a private outreach log with one row per person you wrote to, holding the date, channel, the reason you used, whether a warm path existed, reply or none, first call or none, open promises and any request not to be contacted. Use for "run reach-outreach-log", "outreach log", "track who I contacted", "outreach tracker", "simple CRM for outreach", "who did I write to last month", "do not contact list", "log my outreach", part of the Claude Guide for Outreach Pack by Polar Bear.
